prompt.project_info: Create a four-panel social-media GRWM collage of an approved adult woman experimenting with red lip makeup in a warm indoor room.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long wavy light-brown hair, expressive playful faces, soft glam makeup, and a black strapless sweetheart-neckline dress. Across four panels she uses a red brush and pink lip gloss, makes a pout, smiles, and playfully sticks out her tongue without sexualized framing.
prompt.composition_elements: Four equal portrait panels in a clean grid collage, medium close-up framing, consistent beige/light-brown textured wall, black dress, red brush, pink gloss, and warm skin palette. Preserve continuity of face, hair, outfit, and props across all panels.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm soft indoor light with a slight glow, sharp subject focus, soft background, candid social-media getting-ready mood, playful feminine glamour.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic social media collage, consistent exposure and white balance across panels, medium close-ups, realistic makeup tools and hands, natural texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic four-panel grid collage in a candid social-media GRWM style, showing an approved adult woman with long wavy light-brown hair wearing a black strapless sweetheart-neckline dress against a textured beige or light-brown wall. In four consistent medium close-up panels she makes a playful pout, smiles while applying lip gloss with a red brush, makes a lighthearted tongue-out expression, and tilts her head with a soft smile. Keep the face, hair, outfit, makeup tools, framing, warm soft indoor light, black-red-pink-beige palette, and natural skin texture consistent across panels. Use sharp subject focus, softly receding background, realistic hands, and subtle grain with no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, mismatched panels, text, logo
